column3: Stop the existing cloud services and offsite workers
Clear previous node files and checkpoint state
Clear previous Scylla, Redis, NATS and PostgreSQL chain state
Build Bookworm binaries; generate and verify Genesis, keys and bundle
Start Scylla and check CQL read/write
Start Redis/Valkey and check read/write
Start NATS JetStream and check messaging
Start PostgreSQL and check database access
Upload Groth16 setup; deploy Sepolia, BSC, Base; write all-chain manifest
Configure all three L1s in Envio; check Hasura health and GraphQL schema
Start coordinator, two realms, psy-services and three L2 indexers
Install offsite prove-proxy and standalone faucet; wait for readiness
Start cloud baseline: one coordinator worker and two realm workers
Start the relayer with three chains from the same L1 manifest
Install backend domains and three separate public L1 RPC routes
Publish matching Groth16 setup artifacts
Check public endpoints and each L1 RPC chain ID
Publish public config using the new three-chain deployments
Publish Bridge, Explorer and IDE using the same deployments
Run the basic protocol transaction smoke test
Add the three offsite workers after the cloud baseline passes
